'''Mustafarian toast''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and its inhabitants [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]].<ref name="Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] operated by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold the [[Toast/Legends|toast]] as a breakfast side with [[Andorian jelly/Legends|Andorian jelly]] for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner also sold [[cream chipped bantha beef]] on Mustafarian toast as part of its breakfast [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] for 5.5 credits.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mustafarian toast was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
